decisions.reason: As a renamed and already well-liked trommel screen with its own product page, it carries prior market acceptance and visible commitment, so management is very unlikely to withdraw it quickly.

A multi-model mobile shredder line promoted on its own page signals substantial development and public commitment, which under escalation of commitment favors staying the course despite early uncertainty.

Although only mentioned on the website, this multi-model mobile grinder line still reflects meaningful investment and fits the firm's mobile processing direction, so management would likely keep it and attribute any weak start to ramp-up effects.

This single stationary electric fine shredder has lower visible commitment than the larger lines, but it matches the firm's push toward tougher and more resource-saving processing solutions, making a near-term withdrawal still unlikely.

The green-waste grinder line is a specialized extension of the firm's mobile equipment portfolio, and the sunk development effort plus strategic fit make management inclined to continue rather than retreat after only one year.
A dedicated page and several models for stationary single-shaft pre-shredders indicate strong investment and strategic importance, so management would be reluctant to reverse course so soon.
